# Button Group

Group a series of Button components with similar actions or functions.
See [Button Group guidelines<i class="mat-icon">launch</i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/button-group/design/)

  <Story of={ButtongroupStories.Basic} />

## Examples

### States

Buttons in a Button Group can have `pressed` and `disabled` states.
